summary: TEN Holdings, Inc. filed an 8-K regarding entry into a Placement Agency Agreement with WestPark Capital, Inc. for a registered direct offering of 7,500,000 shares of common stock at $1.00 per share (based on gross proceeds of ~$7.5M). The offering is expected to close on June 30, 2026. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No special-situation features such as a change of control, tender, spin-off, or restructuring are present.
